Training batch 1 at −2.6 costs +0.00261 (glucose_finger +0.008 per row, glucose_lab +0.002). Six batches now average about 0.0028, with a batch-to-batch spread of about 0.0013, so the mean is known to about ±0.0005. Next is training batch 2. If the batches keep averaging below about 0.003, the risk at −2.6 for an evaluation of a few hundred stays or more is around 1–2%, which I would accept for the closer x2 readout.
